literal: possible by the manner virtuous deed without ceasing going place all should do
translation: Perform virtuous deeds without ceasing, in every possible way and at every available opportunity.
modern: உங்களால் முடிந்த வழிகளில் எல்லாம், வாய்ப்பு கிடைக்கும் இடங்களில் எல்லாம், இடைவிடாமல் அறச்செயல்களைச் செய்ய வேண்டும்.
explanation: This couplet urges continuous and practical commitment to virtue. The word 'ஒல்லும்' means what is possible, suggesting that one should do good deeds according to their own capacity and means. 'செல்லும் வாய்' refers to every place or opportunity one encounters in life. Together, the couplet teaches that practicing virtue is not limited to specific times or grand gestures, but should be a constant, unceasing effort in everyday situations.
